title: Minder werk, minder geld 1978
authors: NSS nv v/h Nederlandse stichting voor de statistiek * Den Haag (primary investigator)
contributors: NSS nv v/h Nederlandse stichting voor de statistiek * Den haag (data collector)
descriptions: Opinion concerning less work, less income/ willingness to create more work for the unemployed. Employment / unemployment / financial situation / inflation / taxes / social insurance premiums / standard of living / shortening of working hours / desirability and acceptance of income-effects. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class/ politics/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
